messages.subject: Caspian Atlas Subscription Agreement — first draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Adam,

We act for Caspian Technologies. Please find the first draft of the SaaS subscription and data licence agreement attached, reflecting the agreed heads of terms. The three open commercial points are drafted to our client's opening position (liability cap at 100% of fees, net 30 payment, 90-day non-renewal notice); we'd welcome your mark-up.

Schedules 1, 3 and 4 (SOW, SLA, DPA) will follow under separate cover this week.

Kind regards,
James Osei
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100 | whitfieldcarter.com
